summary_md: **LM Studio ([@lmstudio](https://x.com/lmstudio/status/2115829031832830252))** announces **oMLX** as an engine in LM Studio, usable with existing MLX models; oMLX is an open-source Apple Silicon inference server with continuous batching and SSD caching ([jundot/omlx](https://github.com/jundot/omlx)).
